public_rationale: On July 23, 2026, IIHS reported that Level 5 vehicles did not yet exist and described Waymo's vehicles as Level 4, operating under specified conditions [e1]. The report does not independently establish whether reliable handling of unusual circumstances remains unsolved or whether that explains the absence of unrestricted autonomy [e1]. It supplies neither evidence establishing the claimed necessity nor a verified Level 5 counterexample with the outlier problem independently shown to remain unsolved [e1]. The conditional forecast remains unresolved on this evidence [e1].
limitations: The evidence provides no independent definition or test establishing whether an outlier solution exists [e1].
Continued Level 5 non-achievement does not establish the conditional claim's necessity [e1].
The report describes the state on July 23, 2026; it does not verify the status through October 28, 2026 [e1].

conditions: without a solution to the outlier problem

statement.excerpt: As far as I can tell, nobody has a real solution to the outlier problem of coping with unusual circumstances; without it, full self driving will remain a pipe dream.
statement.document_title: Will Tesla ever “Solve” Full Self Driving?

from_speaker: the outlier problem of coping with unusual circumstances
full self driving will remain a pipe dream
our_interpretation: Assess the conditional forecast, rather than separately grading the preceding qualified observation.
In context, full self-driving means Level 5 operation across human-drivable roads and conditions.
A solution means reliable handling of unusual driving circumstances, not perfect avoidance of every conceivable accident.
The absence of Level 5 deployment does not establish either the antecedent or the claimed necessity.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes that reliable handling of unusual circumstances is necessary for unrestricted autonomous driving, with the absence of such a solution independently established.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified Level 5 system achieves unrestricted autonomy while independent evidence establishes that it has not solved reliable handling of unusual circumstances.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Independent technical evidence that tests unusual-situation handling separately from Level 5 capability, establishes the absence of a solution, and demonstrates that such a solution is necessary for unrestricted autonomy. A dated, independently verified Level 5 achievement while the absence of an outlier solution is separately established would conclusively contradict the forecast.
